assessment: This work is of interest to readers in the field of bone regeneration, and more broadly to readers in the field of tissue repair and regenerative medicine. The authors took advantage of a well–established in vivo model, live imaging, pharmacological inhibition, and genetic strategies to dissect the interrelations of key cellular events in zebrafish fin regeneration. The finding of how distinct generic injury responses are differentially regulated and are functioning independently from each other, is a valuable piece of information for the community.
